user_request: Fix the security finding (untrusted code loading via repository-controlled module resolution) in the Claude SDK launch: the host resolves the SDK from the user's global npm root, run from the home directory, and the sidecar loads only an explicit absolute --sdk-module.
instructions:
NEVER run git stash, git checkout, git reset, git restore, git clean, git merge, git rebase, git push, git commit, git mv or any command that changes the index, the stash stack, or other worktrees' state. Do NOT touch crates/ajax-web/web/. Do NOT write to /tmp. No `timeout` binary on this host: use the perl alarm form. Do NOT explore beyond the named reads (claude_sdk_spawn.rs, resolveSdk in the sidecar, the first 80 lines of claude_sidecar_override_tests.rs, mod.rs). FIRST action: edit claude_sdk_spawn.rs. When you edit mod.rs every `mod *_tests;` line must stay directly preceded by its own #[cfg(test)]; re-read after editing. Do not commit.

FACTS (verified; do not explore).

THE FINDING (security review): the Claude sidecar is spawned with the TASK WORKTREE as its working directory (ClaudeSdkClient::spawn passes the worktree to JsonlProcess::spawn), and the worktree is repository-controlled. In crates/ajax-web/sidecar/claude_sdk_sidecar.mjs `resolveSdk()` (about lines 105-145) tries, when no `--sdk-module` is given: (a) `import('@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk')`, a BARE specifier that Node resolves from the process cwd, so a repository that ships node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk gets its code loaded and run inside the Ajax server; (b) `execFileSync('npm', ['root','-g'])` with no cwd option, so it runs inside the worktree where a project .npmrc can redirect the 'global' root to an attacker directory, followed by imports of `${root}/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` and `${root}/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs`. The sidecar file also has `import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";` (line 23) only for that.

THE FIX (exact): the Rust HOST resolves the SDK from a trusted location and passes an absolute `--sdk-module`; the sidecar loads ONLY an explicit `--sdk-module` and never resolves anything itself.

(1) claude_sdk_spawn.rs (this directory), production branch of `claude_launch()` (today: `resolve_program("node")` then `super::claude_sdk_client::sidecar_launch_args(None)`): replace with: node = resolve_program("node") as today; `let root = global_npm_root().ok_or_else(|| AcpSpawnError::Message("no loadable claude-agent-sdk module: npm root -g failed - npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk".into()))?;` `let module = sdk_module_from_npm_root(&root).ok_or_else(|| AcpSpawnError::Message(format!("no loadable claude-agent-sdk module under {} - npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk", root.display())))?;` then args = `sidecar_launch_args(Some(&module.to_string_lossy()))`. Add these two helpers (both `pub(super)` so tests in this directory can call them):
  `pub(super) fn sdk_module_from_npm_root(root: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf>`: pure; returns the FIRST existing file (use `Path::is_file`) of: `root/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs`, then `root/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs`; None if neither exists.
  `fn global_npm_root() -> Option<PathBuf>`: `let npm = crate::adapters::program::resolve_program("npm")?;` run `std::process::Command::new(npm).args(["root", "-g"]).current_dir(<the user's home directory from std::env::var_os("HOME"), return None when it is unset or not an existing directory>).stdin(Stdio::null()).stderr(Stdio::null()).output()` (NEVER the worktree or the process cwd, so a repository .npmrc is never read); require output.status.success(); take stdout as UTF-8, trim; require a non-empty ABSOLUTE path (`Path::is_absolute`) else None.
  The existing cfg(test) override branch of claude_launch stays EXACTLY as it is. The existing spawn_claude_sdk mapping that appends ` - npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` to messages containing "no loadable claude-agent-sdk module" must not double the hint: these new Err messages already END with the hint, so change that mapping to append only when the text does not already contain "npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk" (the existing test `missing_sdk_error_names_the_install_command` must keep passing unedited).
(2) the sidecar: in resolveSdk() remove the package-import spec, the whole `npm root -g` try/catch and both global-root specs, and delete the now-unused `execFileSync` import. With `--sdk-module <path>` present behavior is EXACTLY as today (exclusive, same error shape `no loadable claude-agent-sdk module; tried: <path> (argv --sdk-module)`). When `--sdk-module` is absent, return `{ mod: null, error: "no --sdk-module given; the host resolves the Claude Agent SDK and passes its absolute path" }` (no import is attempted). Update the comment above resolveSdk to say the sidecar never resolves modules itself. Keep the sidecar under 420 lines and `node --check` passing.
(3) static fixtures (create these small files; NOT under any node_modules directory because .gitignore ignores node_modules): `crates/ajax-web/tests/fixtures/npm_roots/direct/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` (contents: a one-line comment `// fixture`), `.../npm_roots/nested_only/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` (same one-line comment), `.../npm_roots/both/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` and `.../npm_roots/both/@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.mjs` (same), and `.../npm_roots/empty/.gitkeep` (empty file; if `.gitkeep` is ignored use any tracked placeholder name such as `README`).
